decisions: t02 sends the function code and the test event object in base64 (the CloudShell CLI v2 default for blobs), with the readable code in the step text. Reason: the pinned check-cli model (awscli 1.46.1) has no --cli-binary-format option, so raw-in-base64-out failed T113. The base64 strings were generated from the code shown in the step texts.
t04 bucket policy commands use the AWS:SourceArn condition key exactly as the official CLI tutorial get-started-cli-tutorial.html does. No text field states the condition key as a fact (brief d062).

t04 uses curl -i on a never-cached object path only once per policy state, with a 30-second wait before each repeat, because CloudFront keeps an error response for a short time (cloudfront-error-caching-default-ttl).
Cost lines quote only amounts that are displays of verified price facts ($0.025, $0.005, $0.10); no per-day sums are computed.
